# Test fixtures

- `edid_mag271qpx_active.bin`: 384-byte EDID (base block + extensions) of the connected MSI MAG 271QPX, read from the registry.
- `edid_mag271qpx_base_only.bin`: 128-byte base-only EDID of a stale registry entry for the same monitor model.
- `hdr_calibration_app.icc`: HDR profile produced by the Windows HDR Calibration app (reference for the MHC2 layout).
- `hdr_calibration_app_2.icc`: a second HDR Calibration app profile, used as an additional MHC2 reference.
- `srgb_inbox.icm`: Windows' inbox `sRGB Color Space Profile.icm`.
- `vendor_mag271qpx.icm`: the monitor vendor's ICC profile for the MAG 271QPX.
